demo.title: basedloans.sh
demo.code:
# Check what you can borrow, with no liquidations
bankr prompt "How much USDC can I get for 0.5 WETH on Based Loans for the short term?"

# Open the loan
bankr prompt "Borrow USDC against 0.5 WETH on Based Loans for the short term"

# Buy your collateral back before the due date
bankr prompt "Buy back my Based Loans loan in full"

# Lend USDC against tokens you choose
bankr prompt "How risky is HYDX to lend against on Based Loans?"
bankr prompt "Deposit 500 USDC on Based Loans and lend up to 500 against WETH"

setup: Requires Bankr skill for transaction execution
Turn on MFA and Enable arbitrary contract calls at bankr.bot → Security
Fund wallet with the collateral token (or USDC to lend) and a little ETH on Base
